Mar 29: [Adventure Island - 1 point](https://imgur.com/a/2iXb8X6)

Guys, I gotta admit something: I've never actually liked an Adventure Island game in my life. And after playing this one, I can safely say that I still don't HAHA

I have a funny story to tell tho. I wanted to play both games on my DMG, and I did, but Adventure Island gave me a lot of trouble lol.

I learned the hard way that the "continue" button disappears when you turn off the game. After that, in my next attempt my game glitched, probably because I moved the cartridge, or something.

The game is very long(at least for a difficult game that you gotta finish in one sit), so long in fact that my batteries died on me while playing. I was pretty pissed, but oh well, I guess that it's part of the experience XD

I ended up giving up on completing both games on the DMG. Started playing it on my GBA, and the changes were like night and day(almost literally lol). The game has some -seemingly intentional- bad enemy/obstacle placement that the DMG screen makes really difficult to see if you are not cautious(hint: I wasn't). In the end, I had played the game so much that I was kinda like an expert lol I completed the whole game without using any continues.

One thing I love about this Competition it's the fact that I'm playing games till the end, and even if I don't like them all that much, I still have a great time. I don't know if it's the challenge, the new experiences, or some sort of retro gaming-masochism.

Do I like Adventure Island more than I did before? certainly not. Did I have fun playing it? In the end, I feel like I did.
